message.content:
A magazine cover features a large red word "TEMPO" at the top. Two men in dark olive-green military uniforms with gold buttons and epaulets stand on a green lawn. They face forward, smiling slightly, and touch their hands together to form a heart shape between them. Above them, small black text reads "Beban Berat BUMN Karya H.82" and "Uang Semir Lukas Enembe H.72". 

In the lower-left, large white text reads "SETERU DALAM SEKAM," followed by smaller white text. Below the lawn is a gray stone ledge above a body of water. The water reflects the two men, but their reflections are transformed. In the reflection, the men wear boxing gloves and appear to be fighting, with fists raised toward each other. The reflection of the text is also visible, mirrored. 

The bottom-left corner contains black text including "26 SEPTEMBER-2 OKTOBER 2022," "RP 50.000," "MAJALAH.TEMPO.CO," a barcode, and a QR code. The overall background transitions from the green grass above to the blue-gray water below.
